verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «لَا تُهْلِكْ». مَزْمُورٌ لِآسَافَ. تَسْبِيحَةٌ
verses.en: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al-taschith, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

verses.he: הֹ֘ודִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨ ׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים הֹ֭ודִינוּ וְקָרֹ֣וב שְׁמֶ֑ךָ סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹותֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: نَحْمَدُكَ، يَا ٱللهُ نَحْمَدُكَ، وَٱسْمُكَ قَرِيبٌ. يُحَدِّثُونَ بِعَجَائِبِكَ.
verses.en: We give thanks unto Thee, O God, we give thanks, and Thy name is near; men tell of Thy wondrous works.
verses.kjv: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, [unto thee] do we give thanks: for [that] thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.web: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

verses.he: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מֹועֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י מֵישָׁרִ֥ים אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃
verses.en: 'When I take the appointed time, I Myself will judge with equity.
verses.kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.web: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

verses.he: נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.ar: ذَابَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَكُلُّ سُكَّانِهَا. أَنَا وَزَنْتُ أَعْمِدَتَهَا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: When the earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved, I Myself establish the pillars of it.' Selah
verses.kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.web: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

verses.he: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַֽ֭הֹולְלִים אַל־תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃
verses.ar: قُلْتُ لِلْمُفْتَخِرِينَ: لَا تَفْتَخِرُوا. وَلِلْأَشْرَارِ: لَا تَرْفَعُوا قَرْنًا.
verses.en: I say unto the arrogant: 'Deal not arrogantly'; and to the wicked: 'Lift not up the horn.'
verses.kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.web: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

verses.he: אַל־תָּרִ֣ימוּ לַמָּרֹ֣ום קַרְנְכֶ֑ם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ בְצַוָּ֣אר עָתָֽק׃
verses.ar: لَا تَرْفَعُوا إِلَى ٱلْعُلَى قَرْنَكُمْ. لَا تَتَكَلَّمُوا بِعُنُقٍ مُتَصَلِّبٍ».
verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high; speak not insolence with a haughty neck.
verses.kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak [not with] a stiff neck.
verses.web: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א מִ֭מֹּוצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר הָרִֽים׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا مِنَ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَلَا مِنْ بَرِّيَّةِ ٱلْجِبَالِ.
verses.en: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the wilderness, cometh lifting up.
verses.kjv: For promotion [cometh] neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.web: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט זֶ֥ה יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל וְזֶ֣ה יָרִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ ٱللهَ هُوَ ٱلْقَاضِي. هَذَا يَضَعُهُ وَهَذَا يَرْفَعُهُ.
verses.en: For God is judge; He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.
verses.kjv: But God [is] the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.web: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

verses.he: כִּ֤י כֹ֪וס בְּֽיַד־יְהוָ֡ה וְיַ֤יִן חָמַ֨ר ׀ מָ֥לֵא מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ יִמְצ֣וּ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ فِي يَدِ ٱلرَّبِّ كَأْسًا وَخَمْرُهَا مُخْتَمِرَةٌ. مَلآنةٌ شَرَابًا مَمْزُوجًا. وَهُوَ يَسْكُبُ مِنْهَا. لَكِنْ عَكَرُهَا يَمَصُّهُ، يَشْرَبُهُ كُلُّ أَشْرَارِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, with foaming wine, full of mixture, and He poureth out of the same; surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
verses.kjv: For in the hand of the LORD [there is] a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring [them] out, [and] drink [them].
verses.web: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

verses.he: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَأُخْبِرُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. أُرَنِّمُ لِإِلَهِ يَعْقُوبَ.
verses.en: But as for me, I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.web: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

verses.he: וְכָל־קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ תְּ֝רֹומַ֗מְנָה קַֽרְנֹ֥ות צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.ar: وَكُلَّ قُرُونِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ أَعْضِبُ. قُرُونُ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ تَنْتَصِبُ.
verses.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
verses.kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.web: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
